'''Gargon Two''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] or [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the [[Gargon system/Legends|Gargon system]] of the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], rumors spread that the extinct [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] were alive in Gargon Two's jungles, but archaeologists discovered that the "Taung" were actually a primitive [[Gargon Two species|species]] trained by the Taung.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Savagery of the Taung}}</ref>
